The present Application has been filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashing the entire proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No.21 of 2025, pending before the Special Judge (POCSO), Haldwani, District Nainital under Sections 376, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 5(j) read with Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
2.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Mukesh Singh Rawat, learned counsel for applicant, Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate for respondent nos.1 & 2 and Mr. Shubhr Rastogi, learned counsel for respondent no.3 and for the victim.
3. The supplementary affidavit, filed by the victim, aged about 17 years, is taken on record.
4. As per the said supplementary affidavit, the victim and the applicant are still in love.
They wanted to marry with each other.
Therefore, victim does not want to prosecute the applicant.
5. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate, has sought three weeks' time to file counter affidavit, if any.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Special Sessions Trial No.21 of 2025 are stayed.
